user.title: Select Reolink Battery source
user.description: Select the existing Reolink Battery integration entry whose saved UID, local credentials, LAN interface, and operation lock will be reused. Credentials are not copied into the PoC entry.

abort.no_source_entries: No configured Reolink Battery integration was found.
abort.already_configured: An RTSP PoC entry already exists for this camera.

init.title: GitHub diagnostics upload
init.description: Optionally upload the secret-safe PoC diagnostics after every live-stream probe. Use a fine-grained GitHub token restricted to this repository with Contents: Read and write. The token is never included in diagnostics. Leave the token field blank to keep the currently saved token.

error.github_token_required: A GitHub token is required when automatic diagnostics upload is enabled.
